北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗但体感很冷，风大干燥，要注意保暖防风保湿哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but feels very cold with strong winds and dryness. Stay warm, protect from wind, and moisturize!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，体感舒适，出门记得带件薄外套，以防着凉哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool, but comfortable. Bring a light jacket when out, just in case!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，体感舒适。外出别忘了添衣，保持好心情哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool, feels comfortable. Don't forget to add layers and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光正好，气温舒适。出门享受好天气，记得防晒补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Perfect sunny weather, comfortable temps. Enjoy the day out, remember sunscreen and hydration!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 细雨绵绵，出门记得带伞，路滑慢行。保持好心情哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, remember your umbrella, and walk carefully on wet roads. Stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，体感偏冷，早晚温差大，要注意及时添衣哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool, feels colder. Big temperature difference, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天风大体感冷，出门多穿衣，防风保暖别感冒哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, windy, and feels cold. Dress warmly, protect from wind, and don't catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 多云微凉，体感稍冷。出门记得添衣，暖暖身子哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and slightly cool, feels a bit cold. Dress warmly and stay cozy!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 细雨濛濛，湿冷感强。出门带伞穿暖，小心湿滑路面哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Misty rain, feels damp and cold. Bring an umbrella, dress warmly, and watch for wet roads!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微冷体感凉，空气干燥。记得多喝水，保暖防寒哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels cool, air is dry. Remember to drink water and stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天湿度高，体感湿凉。多穿衣，注意保暖，别着凉哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with high humidity, feels damp and cool. Dress warmly to keep the cold away!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 大雪纷飞，天寒地冻！出门全副武装，注意防滑保暖哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Heavy snow, freezing cold! Dress in full gear, watch for slippery roads and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 大雪纷飞湿冷刺骨，多穿厚衣，防滑防寒，暖暖的哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Heavy snow and biting cold. Wear thick clothes, watch for slips, and stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，体感稍冷。出门添衣，享受春城慢时光哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool, feels a bit cold. Dress warmly and enjoy the slow pace of Spring City!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云舒适，气温宜人。出门享受好天气，记得防晒哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and comfortable, pleasant temperature. Enjoy the weather outside, remember sunscreen!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨阵阵，风大湿冷。多穿衣，出门带伞，注意保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and strong, damp winds. Dress warmly, bring an umbrella, and stay cozy!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微冷体感湿凉。注意保暖，多喝热水，别着凉哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels damp and cool. Stay warm, drink hot water, and don't catch a cold!
